verdict.line: You lose if you trade into Snip Snip! on cooldown without a dodge window; you win if you force all-ins after baiting out Q and E.

brief.thesis: Gwen's Q (Snip Snip!) has a hard cooldown of 6.5s at rank 1 that drops to 3.5s at rank 5, and she needs it on cooldown before she's forced to stand and trade in melee range. Jax's E (Counter Strike) dodges every basic attack she throws during its stance, which punishes her for having to auto you between Q resets. This is the 51% win rate over 1006 games: a mechanically even lane where the player who tracks cooldowns wins the all-in.

theirWindow.when: Right after she lands full Snip Snip!
theirWindow.what: She has true damage on you and healed off her passive, so she can afford to stand and keep autoing. Don't greed a trade here; back off until her Q is down.

yourWindow.when: Her Q and E are both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: This is your all-in window. Leap Strike (Q) in, Empower (W) an auto, and pop Counter Strike (E) the moment she tries to auto back — the stun locks her in place for your Relentless Assault (R) attack speed stacking.

start.why: 51.8% win rate over 811 games and 67.2% pick rate — the sustained AD and lifesteal on minion last-hits outlasts her passive's health-percent magic damage in extended trades.

boots.why: 54% win rate over 302 games. Her Q hits for true damage on the center target and her passive scales off your current health, so the flat damage reduction against her auto-reset pokes matters more than magic resist.

core.why: Core in the 49.1% win rate, 17.4% pick path — the on-hit proc and cooldown reduction let you reset Leap Strike faster to punish her Q cooldown windows.
Second item in the same path — the on-hit true damage and healing on crit keeps you ahead in the all-in trade once Counter Strike lands.
Third item in the 49.1% path — lets you survive her Needlework (R) burst if she has ultimate up during your all-in.

runes.keystoneWhy: The 49.3% win rate, 37.2% pick page — stacking attack speed through her Hallowed Mist (W) means your Relentless Assault (R) third-hit procs come online faster than she can disengage.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 77.5% of games at a 52.1% win rate — Ignite denies her passive healing on the all-in burst you set up with Counter Strike.

playing.title: Track her Q cooldown, not yours
playing.detail: Her Snip Snip! (Q) goes from 6.5s at rank 1 to 3.5s at rank 5. Every trade you take while it's up eats true damage on top of her passive; wait for it to go on cooldown before committing.

playing.title: Save Counter Strike for her auto-reset
playing.detail: Counter Strike (E) dodges all incoming basic attacks. She has to land autos between Q casts to proc her passive's bonus magic damage, so timing E around her auto windows denies that damage entirely.

playing.title: Punish her E dash before she resets it
playing.detail: Skip 'n Slash (E) only refunds its cooldown if she hits something during the buff window. If she whiffs the dash, she's stuck with an 11-13s cooldown ability down — that's your all-in window.

playing.title: Leap Strike through minions to engage
playing.detail: Leap Strike (Q) has a 700 range and can target minions, letting you close the gap on her even if she's playing passive behind creep wave.

playing.title: Empower your first hit in every trade
playing.detail: Empower (W) is up every 3-7s depending on rank. Always load it before your first Leap Strike or auto in a trade window — it's wasted if you're not actively fighting.

playing.title: Don't chase into Hallowed Mist
playing.detail: Hallowed Mist (W) only lets enemies who enter it target her. If she backs into her mist, disengage rather than walking in — you lose the ability to be targeted by her outside it, but she can still poke you from safety.

playing.title: Hold R for the stun, not the chase
playing.detail: Relentless Assault (R) has 0s cooldown and scales off consecutive attacks. Pop it the moment Counter Strike's stun lands so your third-hit bonus damage procs land during the stun window, not after she's already disengaged.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the cooldown timings, ability mechanics, and tactical sequencing are the author's own read of the matchup.
